summary: Construct with an array-like argument list and optional distinct newTarget.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.new_target: defaults to target; if supplied must be a constructor
semantics.prototype_selection: construction uses newTarget semantics, including newTarget.prototype

caveats: Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.

tests.name: distinct newTarget controls prototype
tests.input: function A(x){this.x=x}; function B(){}; const o=Reflect.construct(A,[7],B); console.log(o.x,Object.getPrototypeOf(o)===B.prototype);

tests.name: non-constructor newTarget throws before argument list conversion
